headline.line: not started: the preflight found seek OOMKilled and the brief has no waiver

summary: The box is still on 926be1e3; nothing was pulled, rebuilt or run. The read-only preflight stopped on one row: seek shows oom=true since 2026-09-14. Everything else was healthy (112 GB free, origin/dev is the expected sha, fast-forward possible).

findings.text: seek was OOMKilled on 2026-09-14 and has run since; its memory is 15.9 of 16 GiB.

proposals.text: Waive the oom row for seek in the brief form, in the operator's words, then rerun the preflight.
proposals.why: the OOM is from 2026-09-14; seek has run since. The runner restarts SEEK only before a Nessie run (with 'seek restart ok'), never before the preflight, so the waiver is the way past this row.
